title: LISTEN TO THIS PRAYER EVERYDAY BEFORE 7:26AM
text: Lift your hands wherever you are. If you're driving, keep your eyes open, but let your spirit be open. >> [music] >> If you're at home, stand up for a moment. There are instructions coming with power. Father, we thank you. We thank you because you are already here. We thank you because the atmosphere is already heavy. We thank you because before the clock struck this hour, you were waiting. Someone whispered, "Jesus, we acknowledge you. We enthrone you. We declare that you are Lord over this moment." >> [music] >> Wherever this sound is entering homes, offices, hospital rooms, buses, barracks, dormitories, let the name of Jesus be lifted. Come on, lift that name. Jesus. Jesus. Jesus. There is no other name given among men by which we must be saved. There is no other name that opens gates without keys. There is no other name that bends systems, hearts, and timelines. Jesus. Now, listen carefully. Before we go any further, share this. Send it to one person. Post it on your status. You may be the reason someone escapes a trap today. Do it quickly because what God is about to release is not random. It is timed. [music] I hear the spirit say, "This is a morning of rerouting." Some of you woke up with pressure. Some of you woke up with confusion. Some of you woke up feeling late, not in time, but in life. But hear the word of the Lord. Mercy is intercepting your morning. Now, let's worship. Begin to thank him. Thank him for preservation. Thank him for breath. Thank him because the enemy tried last night and failed. Open your mouth. Father, we thank you. We thank you for keeping us while we slept. We thank you because you did not allow our souls to be harvested in the night. We thank you because arrows that fly by night did not locate us. Psalm 91:5 says, "You shall not be afraid of the terror by night nor of the arrow that flies by day. Thank him. Thank him because your name was not mentioned for evil in the covenants of darkness. Thank him because even if it was mentioned, the blood answered. Come on, thank him. Now slow down. There is a melody rising. Begin to sing softly wherever you are. Jesus. Jesus. Precious Jesus. You don't need a perfect voice, you need a surrendered heart. Jesus. Jesus. We worship you not because things are perfect. We worship you because you are faithful. We worship you because you are consistent. We worship you because you are ancient >> [music] >> and yet present. Holy Spirit. Holy Spirit. Take over this moment. Let distractions fall. Let heaviness lift. Let spiritual dullness be broken. I declare every fog around your mind clears now. Now listen. This morning prayer is not ordinary. This before 7:00 a.m. prayer is a gate. Hear me by the spirit. There are favors that do not respond to effort. They respond to alignment. There are doors that will never open by networking. They open by timing. And one of the greatest secrets of favor is what you do before the day begins. Psalm 5 verses 3 says, "My voice you shall hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning I will direct it to you and I will look up." That means there is a way to speak to God that positions you to expect. Some of you have been praying but you've not been looking up. You prayed and still expected defeat. Today that pattern breaks. Exodus 33 verses 13. "Now therefore I pray, if I have found grace in your sight, show me now your way that I may know you and that I may find grace in your sight. Grace can be found. Favor can be found, but it responds to posture. Hear this carefully. Favor is not luck. Favor is alignment with divine preference and before 7:00 a.m. realms are quieter. Before 7:00 a.m. voices are fewer. Before 7:00 a.m. the heart is more open. That's why the enemy fights mornings. That's why alarms fail. That's why sleep becomes heavier when destiny is close. But today you are awake. And because you are awake, I decree something awakens for you. Now lift your right hand. Say this slowly. Father, today I align Say it again, with authority. Father, today I align Now pray this. By the blood of Jesus, I step into divine favor. Again, by the blood of Jesus, I step into divine favor. Let me prophesy. I see files being reopened. I see conversations changing tone. I see help coming from people who were previously silent. Someone watching me, your name is Esther. The Lord says, I am changing how they perceive you. Another person, Michael, there has been resistance around your name. This morning it breaks. A woman named Grace, listen, the delay was not denial. Today speed enters your journey. Now we pray. Father, in the name of Jesus, we declare that this day will not be ordinary. According to Psalm 90:14, "Oh satisfy us early with your mercy, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days." Father, satisfy us early. Early favor. Early help. early answers. Let mercy speak before judgment. Let favor speak before protocol. I decree where others struggle today, you will be helped. Now enter warfare. Open your mouth. Every power assigned to frustrate my day, scatter now again with fire. Every power assigned to frustrate my day, scatter now. I declare by the authority of Jesus, no bad news today. No negative call today. No demonic interruption today. According to Isaiah 54:17, no weapon formed against you shall prosper. Weapons can form, but they will not prosper. I decree every planned embarrassment is canceled. [music] Now pray this loudly. I refuse to be invisible today. Again, I refuse to be invisible today. Favor for causes visibility without noise. Help comes without begging. I decree you will be remembered for good. Someone shout amen. Now lift both hands. Holy Spirit, step in. Let angels be dispatched. Hebrews 1:14, are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who shall inherit salvation? I declare angels go ahead of you. Angels rearrange meetings. Angels influence decisions. Angels block traps. I see an angel standing between you and an accident. I see an angel standing between you and wrong timing. Now we go deeper. Pray this. Every covenant speaking against my favor, break now. Again, every covenant speaking against my favor, break now. By the blood of the everlasting covenant, I disconnect from ancestral patterns of rejection. Hear this prophetic word. What rejected your father will not reject you. What delayed your mother will not delay you. I decree the cycle ends here. Someone watching your name is Daniel. You've been battling recurring disappointment around opportunities. The Lord says today I give you ease. Now listen, favor is not just about what comes to you. It is also about what is kept away from you. Psalm 37:23 says, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord." That means missteps are corrected before they happen. This morning God is correcting steps. Pray this slowly. Father, order my steps today. Again, Father, order my steps today. Now pray it with fire. Every step that will bring regret be redirected now. Again, every step that will bring regret be redirected now. I decree you will not send the wrong message. You will not make the wrong call. You will not enter the wrong place at the wrong time. I see someone who narrowly avoids a mistake today. You later say if not for God. Now listen carefully, there are faces God uses as gates. When favor comes, it often comes wearing a human face. That's why the enemy fights relationships. But today, Proverbs 18:16, "A man's gift makes room for him and brings him before great men." I declare your gift will speak today. Lift your right hand. Say, "My gift will not be hidden today." Again, "My gift will not be hidden today." I prophesy your competence will be noticed. Your effort will be acknowledged. Your contribution will be valued. Someone watching your name is Andrew. You've been faithful in obscurity. The Lord says today I reward consistency. Now let's deal with spiritual resistance. Some delays are not natural. Some frustrations are not accidental. Ephesians 6:12 says we wrestle not against flesh and blood. So we wrestle. Open your mouth now. Every resistance at the gate of my day bow now in the name of Jesus. Again louder. Every resistance at the gate of my day bow now in the name of Jesus. I decree smoothness enters your schedule. Ease enters your movements. Confusion clears. Now we go into family lines. Because favor that doesn't touch family will always be incomplete. Pray this. Every inherited pattern blocking favor break now. Again every inherited pattern blocking favor break now. I break rejection patterns, last minute disappointments, near success failures. I decree you will finish strong. Someone watching your name is blessing. Your family has seen repeated disappointments around the same area. The Lord says you are the interruption. Now finances again but listen carefully. This is not shouting time. This is instruction time. Favor responds to honor. Malachi 3:10 bring all the tides into the storehouse and prove me now. I hear the spirit say correct what you have been ignoring. Some of you favor was waiting for obedience. Quietly pray. Lord I realign my obedience. Again Lord I realign my obedience. I decree mercy covers your past. Wisdom governs your future. Now health. Some sicknesses are stress based. Some are fear fed. Psalm 107:20 he sent his word and healed them. I send a word now. Be healed in your nervous system. Be healed in your digestion. Be healed in your sleep patterns. >> [music] >> Someone watching, you've not slept deeply in weeks. Tonight rest returns. Now, witchcraft resistance again, but listen, the enemy does not need permission when people are ignorant, but knowledge restores authority. Pray this boldly. Every spiritual surveillance over my life, shut down now. Again, every spiritual surveillance over my life, shut down now. I decree monitoring eyes go blind. Evil mirrors shatter. Negative dreams cease. Psalm 91 verses 11, he shall give his angels charge over you. Angels are being reassigned now. I see angelic movement around doors, roads, conversations. Now we enter virtue preservation. Some of you have been leaking strength emotionally. Pray this. Every drain on my virtue be sealed now. Again, every drain on my virtue be sealed now. I decree no emotional manipulation today. No unnecessary arguments. No strength waste us. Now, stay alert. There is a prophetic interruption coming. I hear a name Joseph. There has been delay around recognition. The Lord says, "I am bringing sudden remembrance." Another name, Naomi. The Lord says, "Your bitterness season is ending." Another Peter. Fear has limited boldness. The spirit says, "Speak today. I am backing you." Now lift both hands. We are not ending. We are ascending. Begin to whisper in the spirit. There is a pressing in the spirit now. Not excitement, authority. I hear the Lord say, "Now speak." >> [music] >> Because favor does not only descend, favor is enforced. Lift your voice. Not fast, not rushed, with consciousness. I decree by the authority of Jesus Christ, today wherever you appear, favor will recognize you. Say it after me, "Wherever I appear today, favor will recognize me." Again, louder, "Wherever I appear today, favor will recognize me." I decree, before you speak, hearts will open. Before you explain, help will rise. Before you ask, answers will form. According to Psalm 102 verses 13, you will arise and have mercy on Zion, for the time to favor her, yes, the set time has come. I declare, this is your set time. Now decree this strongly, "I step into my set time today." Again, "I step into my set time today." I decree, mis-timings are corrected, delayed responses are accelerated, postponed help is released. I see someone receiving a message earlier than expected. I see someone being called back after silence. I see someone being smiled at by someone who was cold before. Now lift your right hand higher. I decree, every door programmed to shut against me today, stay open by fire. Again, every door programmed to shut against me today, stay open by fire. According to Revelation 3 verses 7, >> [music] >> what he opens, no one can shut, and what he shuts, no one can open. I declare, God opens, men comply. Now decree, "I will not beg today." Again, "I will not beg today. I decree you will not reduce yourself to be accepted. You will not compromise to be helped. You will not struggle to be honored. Favor will meet you at your level. Now, we address spoken words. Some battles are not spiritual altars. They are careless utterances. Proverbs 18:21, "Death and life are in the power of the tongue." So, we correct the record. Say this clearly, "Every negative word I spoke yesterday, I cancel you now." Again, "Every negative word I spoke yesterday, I cancel you now. I decree words spoken in fear lose power. Words spoken in frustration are neutralized. Words spoken ignorantly are overridden by mercy." Now, lift both hands. I decree by prophetic authority, "Today, no embarrassment, no shame, no sudden bad news." Isaiah 61:7, "Instead of your shame, you shall have double honor." I declare honor finds you today. Someone watching, your name is Emmanuel. The Lord says, "I am correcting how they address you." Another, your name is Hannah. There has been emotional exhaustion. The Lord says, "I am restoring your joy today." Now, decree this slowly, "Today, I walk under divine covering." Again, "Today, I walk under divine covering." I decree roads are covered, conversations are covered, decisions are covered. Psalm 121:8, "The Lord shall preserve your going out and your coming in." I declare you will return safely. You will return fulfilled. You will return with testimony. Now, pray this with fire. Every plan of the enemy for today collapse now. Again, every plan of the enemy for today collapse now. I decree traps fail, ambushes scatter, confusion returns to the camp of darkness. Lift your hands again gently. I hear the spirit say now I am marking people. Not with noise, not with drama, with distinction. Exodus 11:7 says, "The Lord will make it different between Egypt and Israel." That difference is being enforced now. Listen carefully. Some of you will do the same thing others do today, but your result will be different. Same office, same road, same system, different outcome. Lift your right hand. Say this with understanding. Father, mark me for distinction today. Again, Father, mark me for distinction today. I decree where others are ignored, you will be noticed. Where others are delayed, you will be advanced. Where others are questioned, you will be trusted. This is not pride. This is favor. Now, we address the day itself because days have personalities. Days can resist or cooperate. Psalm 118:24, "This is the day the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it." That means the day must submit to God's intention. So, we command [music] the day. Lift your voice. Today, hear the word of the Lord. Again, today, hear the word of the Lord. I decree you will not produce stress. You will not produce sorrow. You will not produce regret. Today, align with heaven. Now, listen. Some attacks don't come as problems. They come as destructions. The enemy tries to pull your focus so favor passes unnoticed. So, pray this. Every distraction assigned to weaken my focus today, disappear now. Again, every distraction assigned to weaken my focus today, disappear now. I decree clarity of mind, sharp judgment, discernment in conversations. James 1:5, "If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God." I release wisdom now. Someone watching you will say the right thing at the right time today. Another you will keep quiet at the right moment today. Both are victories. I decree by the authority of Jesus, no sudden loss today, no strange expenses today, no unexpected breakdown today. Psalm 91:10, "No evil shall befall you, nor shall any plague come near your dwelling." I extend that covering to your belongings, your documents, your finances, your body. Now, say this firmly. I am divinely insured today. Again, I am divinely insured today. Now, pause for a moment. Breathe. I sense someone struggling with inner pressure, not external attack, but heaviness inside. Hear me, that heaviness is lifting now. Matthew 11:28, "Come to me, all you who labor and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest." I decree rest in your soul, rest in your emotions, rest in your thoughts. Someone watching your name is peace. You've been fighting anxiety quietly. The Lord says, "I give you rest today." Now, we deal with spoken opposition. There are people who will speak today. Some knowingly, some ignorantly, but their words will not prevail. >> [music] >> Isaiah 54:17, "Every tongue which rises against you in judgment, you shall condemn." Lift your voice. Every tongue assigned to rise against me today, I condemn you now. Again, every tongue assigned to rise against me today, I condemn you now. I decree, false accusations fail, harsh words lose weight, negative opinions dissolve, your reputation is preserved. Now, enter a moment of quiet tongues. Not loud, not rushed. Let it flow. Rash taleba, koto koshe, alamandria, shutta labros. Now, listen carefully. There is favor for today, but there is also favor that plants seeds for tomorrow. Some encounters today are not rewards, they are introductions. Some helps today are not answers, they are gateways. That is why we must pray with intelligence now. Lift your right hand again. Say this slowly, with awareness. Father, I receive favor that outlives today. Again, Father, I receive favor that outlives today. I decree, connections today will not expire. Help today will not be withdrawn. Mercy today will not turn into regret. According to Proverbs 4:18, "The path of the just is like the shining sun that shines ever brighter." I declare, your path brightens from today. Now, we address appointments. Some of you have meetings today. Some have conversations. Some have silent observations. But all of them matter. Pray this. Every appointment assigned to waste my time today, be canceled now. Again, every appointment assigned to waste my time today, be canceled now. I decree, you will not sit where nothing happens. You will not speak where no one listens. You will not invest energy where nothing grows. Today, efficiency enters your life. Now, listen. Favor is attracted to accuracy. That's why we must pray for alignment between your words, your actions, and God's intent. Lift both hands. Say this, "Father, align my words today." Again, "Father, align my words today." I decree you will not overshare. You will not undersell yourself. You will not speak fear. What you say today will help you. Now, we address hidden helpers. There are people God has already positioned, but fear, delay, or pride can block access. So, we pray. Say this firmly, "Every barrier between me and my helpers collapse now." Again, "Every barrier between me and my helpers collapse now." I decree pride dissolves, fear melts, miscommunication clears, helpers will recognize you, you will recognize helpers. Someone watching, your name is Isaac. There has been help near you, but timing was off. The Lord says, "Today, I synchronize timing." Now, we move to territorial favor because favor is not only personal, it can be geographic. Lift your voice. "Every territory I step into today open to me by favor." Again, "Every territory I step into today open to me by favor." I decree roads cooperate, spaces welcome you, environments respond. You will not feel out of place today. Now, hear this prophetic instruction. Do not rush decisions today. Favor is already ahead, speed is not required. I speak calm into your spirit. Now, we pray against fatigue. Some of you are tired not because of work, but because of prolonged resistance. Say this, "Every weariness of the soul, lift now." Again, "Every weariness of the soul, lift now. I decree fresh strength, renewed motivation, restoration of joy." Isaiah 40:31, "They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength." I release renewal now. Now, listen. Gratitude tells heaven, "I recognize what you have done even before I see it fully." And God responds to recognition. So, begin to thank him. Not loudly, not mechanically, with awareness. Father, [music] we thank you. We thank you for hearing us. We thank you because you did not ignore us this morning. We thank you because before the day fully began, you stepped into it. Thank him. Thank him for favor released. Thank him for protection activated. Thank him for helpers aligned. Thank him for traps avoided, even the ones you will never know about. Say it in your own words. Thank you, Lord. Psalm 118:1 says, "Oh, give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his mercy endures forever." Father, we acknowledge your mercy. Mercy that spoke instead of judgment. Mercy that covered instead of exposing. Mercy that went ahead of us today. We say thank you. We thank you for strength in our bodies. We thank you for clarity in our minds. We thank you for peace in our hearts. We thank you because today is not ordinary. We thank you because favor has been released quietly, intentionally, and effectively. Father, receive our gratitude. We return all glory to you. We return all honor to you. Negative association attached to your name be cleared. Proverbs 22:1 says, "A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches." So, I decree honor, respect, and credibility. I speak to your destiny. Every agenda of postponement canceled. Habakkuk 2:3 says, "At the appointed time it shall speak and it shall not lie." So, I decree your appointed time is active. Your season is open. Your door is unlocked. Now, lift both hands. This is the final prophetic seal. By the authority of Jesus Christ, I seal your mind against confusion. I seal your heart against fear. I seal your body against sickness. I seal your steps against error. I seal your destiny against sabotage. No replay of old battles. No return of former struggles. No recycling of pain. Nahum 1:9 again, "Affliction shall not rise a second time." So, I decree this ends here. This ends [music] permanently. Now, pray softly in the spirit slow victorious. Rabashata, Mantoroboshata, Zelegateraba. Yes, it is finished. It is sealed. It is enforced. Go. Walk into favor. Walk into alignment. Walk into testimony. You beat the enemy to your day. You stayed ahead. You finished well. Amen. >> Mhm.
